Title: AccuraSoftHire PolinRider loader - domain
Description: Fake AccuraSoftHire careers site that serves the PolinRider loader to job candidates as a camera driver, VS Code setup and notification-settings download. Source: JFrog Security Research – Contagious Interview: One Interview Away From Infection https://research.jfrog.com/post/accurasofthire-fake-interview/; StepSecurity – Inside the AccuraSoftHire fake interview campaign https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/accurasofthire-fake-interview-developer-machines
RecommendedActions: Isolate the developer machine, rotate every credential on it (git, SSH, cloud, npm, browser) and check its repositories for injected loader code.

Title: AccuraSoftHire PolinRider loader - ipv4
Description: PolinRider loader C2 that the camera-driver payload was pointed at, decoded from the operator's Ethereum dead-drop wallet; serves stages from /0x/cls and /0x/ls over plain HTTP on port 443.
